save.text: 0: MATT introduces CR Channel and subscriber giveaway; first winner LL1973 for 4200 subs; next at 4250; owner of signed PHB and cast photo mentioned.
7-12: No CR episode next week due to San Diego Comic-Con; panels Thursday at PetCo Park; main Geek and Sundry panel 1-2 with Laura; full CR panel 4-5; stream coverage next day.
13-15: Marisha and Orion discussing planning; Liam joins via Skype; Liam in upstate NY near Canadian border; conversation about expatriotism and late-night driving; warning not to go Canadian.
37-39: Orion comments it's a podcast; old-time radio vibe; intro video frozen;
43-46: Matt hints last game for a while; Laura cautions not to say it yet; Travis says 'If you say it, it makes it true'
51-54: Travis will leave show; Matt refutes (Grog's ale still needs to be filled); pizza at the ready; awaiting departure.
58-63: Behind-the-scene setup confirmed; table behind computer; Travis behind Matt; Laura notes visibility and proximity; discussion of camera/framing improvements.
Intro video issues acknowledged; team decided to jump into game rather than fix intro, live confusion noted.
Sam joins; Matt announces with lines 135-139; Sam presence confirmed.
Campaign recap established: Horn of Orcus sealed in Platinum Sanctuary in Vasselheim; voyage on skyship; encounter with wyvern/griffin bandits; capture taken.
151-156: Laura, Travis, Matt discuss prisoner on ship; mage female captive bound by captain's orders; captain Damon reluctant to work with her; locked up in anti-magic brig.
157-161: Fate of prisoner unsettled; anti-magic brig specified; beard-growing session begins; Dylan? (note: character names correct: Grog beard scene, Tr.*)
162-170: Sam comments on brig and beard; attempts to grow beard encouraged; dice rolling rules clarified (percentage dice).
171-176: Beard growth dramatization; misunderstanding of dice (two d10s); behind-the-scenes humor noted.
177-183: Beard progress; description of peach-fuzz; audience reaction; Grog teased as Targaryen; beads for beard discussed.
184-189: Liam comments on hot/Grog look; live audience banter continues; reactions to beard visuals.
190-196: Grog beard prep discussed; arcane caution on goliath physiology; beads/beads integration; plan to braid beard.
197-205: Bead braiding session initiated; visual styling of beard; roleplay humor about Gandalf; beads/flowers added.
206-213: Visual braid takes form; Grasping Vine joke; DM prompts potential magical mishap; players banter about beard magic.
214-221: MV: teasing about consequences of beard magic; Orc and Sam push-pull between violence and humor; general mood light.
222-231: Rested days passage; trinket healing; rope goatee experiment by Liam; rope-frayed goatee attached with spirit gum; perception check planned.
232-233: Looming sleep-day check; Travis attempts dice checks while asleep; meta-humor on perception check with disadvantage.
234-235: Sleep check result gag; Travis laughs; Orion comments on timing.
238-245: Morning beard status confirmed: MATT describes Grog's goatee as glorious, dark brown, well-braided, mildly frayed, 3-4 inches; Grog proud.
246-254: Marisha performs nature check; weather appears cold, northern continent; Orion senses weather.
255-265: Light roleplay banter about weather; Slate gag; Laura/Orion/Scanlan interactions; setup for wall of stone improvisation.
274-279: Ship-wall spell: Wall of Stone improvised as thin shale; misfit for full wall; Scanlan mocked for underuse of Prestidigitation; Orion critiques wand usage.
283-289: Tension between magical ability and wisdom debated; Bearded humor continues; Beards of glory joke; group interactions about item usefulness.
317-321: Orion explains storing up to three level spells; contrast with Pearl of Power: better than Pearl; no spell slots expended.
325-332: Orion explains three Lightning Bolts in storage; Laura/Travis reactions; stone details continue.
350-355: Snowing observed; mood shift to Festivus; party banter continues.
406-463: New dialogue establishing arrival at Othanzia; Key NPC Kima introduction; Vesper Timberland description; Tracing of city fortress with dragon-headed ballistae; mood and setting notes.
477-478: Arrival at Vasselheim; city is old with damaged/rebuilt walls; scaffolded platform on mill; ship prepares to dock; Horn of Orcus box with Scalebearers and Kima present.
481-489: Party discusses familiarity with city; weather cold; rest planning for approach; dialogue about travel accommodations and gear.
526-539: Sam casts Lightning Bolt into Ioun Stone; third-level bolt saved; Stone glows greenish-white; confirmation that slot used but stored.
543-546: Ship halts near docking; Trinket lowered; Kima offers guidance; question about Horn of Orcus location asked by Laura; escorts implied.

643-646: Party commentary on Sarenrae; Orion changes appearance (Alter Self to gold); tension about public display.
717-718: Vasselheim described as ancient, holiest modern site; arcane generally profane in public due to holiness; deities emphasized: Arathis, Avandra, Melora, Bahamut; Sarenrae not discussed here.

1310-1319: New dialogue segment shows party advancing through a lighted chamber with traps; perception check by Laura (16) and Liam (29); circular room with floor pressure plates; stairs descend to a wide open shaft; Boots of Haste used by Liam; first trap interaction results in room rotation and rising pillars; Liam narrowly avoids major damage but takes some—crushing damage 40; acrobatics checks required to move through rotating pillars.
Status: ongoing VCR-style session (Critical hit chance, rotating mill room) with Vax attempt; perception check reveals ceiling hole aligned with pillar—possible weak point for mechanism.
Action: Laura (Vex) with arrow attempt through ceiling hole; bonus from Inspire and Enhance Ability discussed; outcome pending shot result (roll 25 noted).
Magic/tech interaction: Orion's ring telekinesis planned to interact with arrow; cooperation with Vex to redirect projectiles.

Status: Combat turn around; arrow shot through ceiling hole triggered mechanism; arcane+tech interaction discussed (Orion ring telekinesis guiding arrow); result: shot made with 17, ricochet/upward trajectory, mechanical damage to pillar mechanism.
Outcome: Pillar-holed mechanism sustains damage; splintering wood/metal and grinding observed; small debris poured from hole; momentary halt of mechanism.
Character responses: Laura praises Vex; Taliesin and Marisha acknowledge near-impossible shot; party heals; short rest planned and taken after event.
Interlude: Five-minute break announced; Teespring promo and charity guest appearances prepared; Orion introduced to stream audience.

1556-1570: Taylor/Orion interview about GameChanger charity; goals: support kids with rare diseases, hospital visits, scholarships; website: gamechangercharity.org; Deus Ex campaign offers free copy with $1+ donation; emphasis on inspiration and hope from games.

1578-1584: Moderation/chat actions discussed; mods have GameChanger link in chat; decision to donate via GameChanger confirmed; 1589-1597: show notes about last day, Deus Ex copy timeframe, and end-break logistics (need to pee, flights).
1602-1611: Post-break announcements; Paula Konito winner; website donation link 826LA redirected to GameChanger; confirmation that donations go to GameChanger rather than 826LA tonight.
